description: This is a Java interface defining the contract for group-related operations within the sales manager application, including listing groups by type or IDs.

classes.name: GroupService
classes.description: An interface extending the generic entity service, providing group-specific operations such as listing groups by type or by IDs.

methods.name: listGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a list of groups filtered by the specified group type.

methods.name: listGroupByIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of groups matching the provided set of group IDs.
